messages:
Amy K: heads up — canary rollout of PyTorch 2.3 + CUDA minor driver landed on dedicated last night, noticed perf wobble on KV-cache heavy small-seq workloads. p50 ~+18%, p99 ~+30% :confused:
Juan C: saw the CI alert too. nightly-perf flagged a regression on the kv-prefetch job around 03:40 UTC. link: https://perf.redwood/compare/kv-prefetch/last-7d :eyes:
CI Bot: nightly-perf detected regression: kv-prefetch-smallseq p50 +17.9% (baseline 12.3ms -> 14.6ms), p99 +29.7%. Suspected kernel selection change. See run 2026-03-17T03:40Z.
Nina R: I ran a quick trace on a failing CI instance. NVTX shows a different GEMM kernel being chosen for batch_size=2, seq=32 after the upgrade. Matmul small-batch path switched from `matmul_small_batch_v2` -> `matmul_generic_fused`.
Sam P: that kernel swap smells like Triton / kernel selector fallback changes in recent PRs. Any candidate commits?
Nina R: bisect in the dedicated image points at two things: (1) the PyTorch 2.3 / cuBLAS minor upgrade that slightly changed alignment heuristics, and (2) PR #4872 in our runtime that tweaked the kernel-selection heuristic to prefer generic fused kernels for <4x4 tile shapes. Both landed ~same window.
Juan C: can you share the perf profile? Perf Bot: profile summary attached -> top 3 kernels: `matmul_generic_fused` 42% self, `softmax_kv` 18%, `kv_prefetch_async` 9%. Matmul_generic_fused latency per call ~2.4x higher for our small-sequence distribution.
Nina R: pasted trace snippet:
```
[trace] matmul_small_batch_v2: 1.9ms (old)
[trace] matmul_generic_fused: 4.6ms (new)
[trace] kv-cache lookup: 0.8ms
```
Sam P: rolling back PR #4872 locally restores matmul_small_batch_v2 selection and perf returns to baseline. So the runtime heuristic change + upstream driver change combined to flip the selector in an unfortunate way.
Amy K: big picture: two small changes individually fine, combined they cross a threshold. This explains why CI only started failing after environment bump.
Juan C: action options: 1) revert runtime PR #4872, 2) patch selector to add explicit preference for matmul_small_batch_v2 for our observed tile shapes, or 3) pin PyTorch/cuda in Dedicated until we can adapt. Thoughts?
Nina R: I built a quick safeguard: if batch<=4 and seq<=64 prefer `matmul_small_batch_v2`. Quick patch + unit test passes locally. I'll open a PR.
Sam P: can we also add a CI microbenchmark that simulates our small-seq KV workload to catch this in pre-merge?
Amy K: yes, add a perf microbenchmark and a guard in rollout (canary hold) for minor env bumps. For now hold the PyTorch 2.3 rollout on Dedicated and start a revert + patch PR.
CI Bot: created ticket RN-2048 and linked nightly-perf trace.
Perf Bot: added alert rule to detect >10% p50 regression in kv-prefetch-smallseq.
Juan C: thanks Nina — please post PR link when ready and mark as rollout-blocker. :thumbsup:
Nina R: PR: https://git.redwood/runtime/pull/4981 - adds selector guard + microbench to ci/perf. Marked as urgent.
Sam P: I'll coordinate an emergency canary rollback for the affected shards and pin torch on Dedicated until PR lands.
Amy K: plan sounds good. keep updates here. :pray:
